name: Tallbell
summary: An AI receptionist named Tally that answers calls from your website knowledge, takes messages, and can book jobs on your calendar.
description: Tallbell is an AI phone receptionist (Tally) that answers calls day and night from your website, takes messages and emails you after each call. Calls under 20 seconds, spam and your own numbers do not count.

pricing.details: Answer 133 €/month (150 calls, 14-day trial: a card is required, nothing is charged today, and you pay nothing if you cancel online before the trial ends); Book 267 €/month (300 calls, calendar booking, same 14-day trial); Grow 445 €/month (600 calls, website and simple CRM, 3-month minimum, no trial). Calls under 20 seconds, spam and your own numbers do not count. Going over never stops answering. Extra calls are billed per call at the official unit rate, which converts to under 1 € at the ECB rate, so no euro figure is shown. A call over 8 minutes counts as two.
pricing.label: Premium
